purpose: Diagnose refinement overshoot, then compare endpoint and intermediate-state objectives without changing the published model, chemistry or training trajectories
primary_method_source: https://repository.lib.ncsu.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/259ce066-870d-4034-8ec7-f140115facfd/content (chapter3 Eq3.13 endpoint MSE; chapter4 is a different CFD study)
development_motivation: https://repository.lib.ncsu.edu/bitstreams/1fa09985-1133-4143-8d1b-a7b663aa6038/download (section3.2.3 progressive autoregressive training; not the original0D H2 protocol)
selection: Validation only: balance the two 12-IC domains, then maximize strict raw full9 plus early0.1ms passes, full9 passes, completion and diagnostic error. Keep update-zero fallback. Select one endpoint and one all-steps candidate; continue their exact final probe Adam/RNG states without restarting.
scope_limits: Endpoint K5 MSE is the chapter-3 objective; learning-rate transfer and optimizer reset are controlled numerical choices, not claimed author settings.
All-intermediate MSE is a separate development arm, motivated by later progressive-rollout literature; it is not an exact reproduction of chapter3 Eq3.13.

Two reconstruction-ANN continuations start from the same saved Adam/RNG state: uniform time versus half uniform/half train-only chemical-arc quantiles. They share architecture, MSE, LR and update targets. A combined model is chosen from a validation-only operator/reconstruction factorial table.
No soft physical loss, training repair, clipping, changed mechanism, changed train-only normalization or architecture.
The existing 127 test ICs have already been inspected and are historical secondary results. Newly frozen 32 ICs are evaluated only after final selection.
The exact private fusion and 20-reaction mechanism remain unavailable; the verified public 10-species/25-entry Burke variant is retained.
If the time cap truncates training, report actual updates; do not call it a plateau or complete paper reproduction.
